objective: Provide a read-only local audit that identifies the exact frozen model, feature dataset, ALeRCE cache and fold artifacts required by the skipped scientific integration tests without substituting lab artifacts.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: 662 tests passed and 11 skipped; 10 skips depend on missing v0.2 model/feature artifacts.

Original checkout contained a separate lab-smoke artifact with model/schema/calibration/conformal/OOD files. The production artifact path was missing. The lab artifact must not substitute for the frozen production artifact.

previous_knowledge_consumed.source: Dropbox artifact search and GitHub Actions artifact inspection
previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: No frozen production model or feature dataset was found in accessible Dropbox or retained GitHub Actions artifacts.

expected_improvement: Verify known lab-smoke hashes while keeping that artifact ineligible for production inference
Provide a safe reproducible local audit command
Prevent accidental symlink/copy substitution of the lab model

correctness.before: Missing artifacts were known from prior test skips, but there was no one-command local inventory.
correctness.after: The audit inventories required model, feature, ALeRCE cache, fold and dependent-test paths; it validates internal manifest/file hashes and requires frozen artifact schema 1.0. It does not authenticate the artifact against an independently pinned original manifest or establish scientific validity.

coverage.before: No consolidated artifact readiness report existed.
coverage.after: The report includes required production model files, feature/config files, raw-cache counts, fold files and explicit dependent-test existence checks.

reliability.before: Lab and production artifacts could be confused by path substitution.
reliability.after: The separate lab-smoke path is marked ineligible, and schema 1.1 is rejected if a later lab artifact is copied into the frozen production path. The original artifact identity remains unverified until an authoritative hash is recovered.

measurement.trade_off: The audit requires one local execution because the original WSL filesystem is not accessible through repository tools. It does not upload or modify scientific data.

evidence: A read-only audit script, documentation and deterministic unit tests were added.
The unit tests and actual local WSL audit have not yet run on the final branch head.

Review identified that the initial readiness flag did not require dependent test modules and could be misread as scientific validation; the audit contract is being tightened to report path prerequisites only.

Inspected the canonical ModelArtifactLoader and ModelArtifactWriter contracts. The original v0.2.0 production artifact is schema 1.0; conformal.json, ood.json and ood_model.joblib are later diagnostic components and are not required for that frozen artifact.
Fixed the local audit script so schema-1.0 baseline readiness requires the baseline files and validates the manifest SHA-256 values; it reports conformal/OOD files as optional diagnostics.
Added regression coverage for a complete schema-1.0 production artifact without optional diagnostic files and for a manifest hash mismatch.
Corrected the test fixture to emit valid JSON for its synthetic artifact manifest. CI validation on the exact final PR head is pending.

Code review found that the initial audit accepted schema 1.1 even though the frozen v0.2.0 production artifact is schema 1.0; a copied schema-1.1 lab-smoke artifact could therefore satisfy the previous readiness check if its internal manifest hashes were self-consistent.
Restricted the frozen production artifact audit to schema 1.0 and added a regression test proving that schema 1.1 is rejected from the production path.

Clarified that internal manifest/hash consistency is not authentication against a trusted original artifact manifest; the original production artifact remains UNRECOVERED until an authoritative external hash/source is available.

Added the focused artifact-audit regression test module to the Scientific Validation contract workflow so it runs for stacked PRs whose base is not main; ordinary CI is configured for pull requests targeting main only.

root_causes: The production model artifact is missing from the accessible repository/CI artifact sources.
The lab-smoke artifact exists in the original local checkout but is a separate run and cannot replace the frozen production model.

The initial PR #278 artifact audit incorrectly placed conformal.json, ood.json and ood_model.joblib in the unconditional required-file list. Those files are optional diagnostic components for the frozen schema-1.0 production artifact, so a valid original artifact could be falsely reported as incomplete.

The local audit initially allowed schema 1.1 for the frozen production path, despite the documented schema-1.0 baseline; this could allow a copied later lab-smoke artifact to be misclassified as eligible.
unresolved: Actual current WSL artifact availability must be confirmed by running the audit script.
The local WSL artifact inventory has not yet been run. The original model remains UNRECOVERED until a hash-verified local audit or authoritative artifact source confirms its presence.

findings: Never symlink or copy lab-smoke model weights into the frozen production artifact path.
Keep large scientific artifacts out of Git.
Use exact SHA-256 and immutable artifact manifests for any external artifact source.
Artifact audit readiness must follow the manifest schema and file declarations. Later optional OOD/conformal files must not be required for a valid frozen schema-1.0 baseline artifact.
The frozen v0.2.0 production artifact schema is 1.0; later schema-1.1 lab-smoke artifacts must fail the production readiness check even when copied into the expected path.

A self-consistent internal artifact manifest proves internal file integrity only. It does not authenticate the artifact against the original publisher/trusted baseline unless the manifest or artifact hash is independently pinned.

open_blockers: Run the corrected artifact audit in the user's WSL checkout and inspect the JSON report.
If the frozen production artifact exists, verify its manifest and run the 10 dependent tests.
If absent, recover it from its original authoritative source; do not rebuild or substitute without a separately approved scientific baseline procedure.
Pass the new schema-1.0/no-optional-diagnostics and manifest-hash-mismatch regression tests on the exact PR #278 head.
Pass the focused artifact-audit regression test in the Scientific Validation workflow and run full standard CI on the integrated main-based candidate.

knowledge_carried_forward: Lab-smoke artifact remains separate and is never production-eligible.
